title: Driver gate green verdict on a seeded workspace

invariants.statement: WHEN the driver gate runs over a seeded green workspace, THE SYSTEM SHALL report ok=true with every stage verdict true (ears, l0, l1, l2_fast) while leaving the workspace byte-identical (no ledger, no verdict cache, no bytecode written).
invariants.property: forall runs r: green_workspace(r) => ok(r) and stages(r) == {ears, l0, l1, l2_fast} and unchanged_workspace(r)
